hook: Borrowman spent more than a decade inside Colgate-Palmolive's Hill's Pet Nutrition division building global digital marketing systems before moving to the European digital transformation role and then into enterprise AI. Her Davos 2026 appearance placed her in the small cohort of marketing leaders publicly shaping the governance and brand questions that agentic AI raises, specifically, how leadership principles should be embedded directly into AI architecture rather than applied after the fact.
name: Christy Borrowman

quote.text: As AI systems move from generating outputs to executing decisions, leadership principles should be embedded directly into AI architecture.
